title: Sources of the Indian Constitution
quote: A "bag of borrowings" - yet adapted to Indian conditions; DPSP a "novel feature"

boxes.title: Country → features
head: Source
Features borrowed
rows: ==Parliamentary govt, **cabinet**, **single citizenship**, **bicameralism**==, Rule of Law, Speaker, writs, privileges
**Fundamental Rights**, **judicial review**, independent judiciary, Preamble idea, **Vice-President**, impeachment, removal of judges
Strong-Centre federation, ==**residuary powers**== with Centre, Governors appointed by Centre, advisory jurisdiction
==**Concurrent List**==, **joint sitting**, freedom of trade, commerce, intercourse, Preamble language
**Fundamental Duties**; social, economic, political justice; Five-Year Plans
